headline: Forecasters at the US National Hurricane Center built their forecast for Hurricane Isaias around a Google DeepMind AI model, and so far it is holding up.
score_reason: Live, concrete example of AI in a public safety forecast; the storm has not yet made landfall.
importance_line: People in the storm's path get an earlier warning of a stronger hurricane if the AI model is right, but the outcome is not yet known and the AI is used alongside physics-based models.
summary: CNN reports that the National Hurricane Center shaped its forecast for Hurricane Isaias around Google DeepMind's AI model from the first advisory on Tuesday, predicting a Category 2 storm when many physics-based models showed a weaker one on a different track. Center director Michael Brennan said the AI models have shown more consistency from one run to the next, and CNN says the bet has paid off so far while the storm heads for the northeastern Gulf Coast.
notes: Read in full. The forecast will only be proven once the storm makes landfall.
